commands.name: inspect_atmosphere
commands.description: Inspect the current environment's atmosphere: sun direction, height, color and strength, sky (installed HDRI or gradient), stars, exposure, eye adaptation, bounce light, contrast, ambient light, fog, haze and shadow distance, time, cloud cover and rain, which of them are edited, and the installed skies.

commands.name: preview_atmosphere
commands.description: Preview atmosphere changes for the current environment. Set only the fields to change. Use time_mode fixed or cycle with time_of_day and day_length, or manual to use sun direction and elevation. Cloud cover and rain are 0 to 1. reset clears earlier edits first. The preview stays until saved or discarded.

commands.name: save_atmosphere
commands.description: Save the previewed atmosphere for this environment.

commands.name: discard_atmosphere
commands.description: Discard the atmosphere preview and restore the saved atmosphere.
